senses.gloss: אַתְלַע same, to become wormy; to rot.—Part. pass. מַתְלַע; pl. מַתְלְעֵי.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:19">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>חיזרא כי מ׳</he> bran that had grown wormy.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10b:11">M. Kat. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דמ׳ וכ׳</he> because the dates may get wormy, they are like goods that may depreciate (and may be attended to during the festive week).
